dimensions.positive_proof: FillerTraits registers Analgesia at cost 8 and its OnPlayerUpdate handler sets pain to 0 while the trait is present. UT changes cost/exclusions deliberately but preserves continuous pain suppression through an OnNewGame marker consumed every OnPlayerUpdate by UT_CORE PainHook.
dimensions.negative_proof: The prior claim that UT_painImmune has no consumer is false: UTCore_PainHook reads the exact key and clears PAIN. Absence in pre-marker legacy saves is backward-migration territory and is not a current-version defect in this audit.

dimensions.positive_proof: OnNewGame(player,square) invokes the one-argument handler, UTCore.hasTrait validates the namespaced trait, and modData.UT_painImmune becomes true. IsoPlayer.update emits OnPlayerUpdate; centralDispatch supplies modData/stats to PainHook, which clears positive PAIN.
dimensions.negative_proof: Without the trait the initializer returns; without a true marker, player, modData, or stats the hook returns; PAIN at 0 causes no write.

dimensions.positive_proof: For every eligible update, PAIN strictly greater than 0 is assigned exactly 0; CharacterStat.PAIN is bounded 0..100 and Stats.set clamps to that range.
dimensions.negative_proof: PAIN=0 is not rewritten, an absent marker leaves positive pain unchanged, and there is no multiplier, partial decrement, or injury exception.

dimensions.positive_proof: Initialization occurs on OnNewGame and suppression is evaluated on each OnPlayerUpdate through a core handler whose throttle is 0.
dimensions.negative_proof: No minute-based event or delayed cadence participates; a pain write after this hook can remain only until the next player-update dispatch.

dimensions.positive_proof: PainHook has throttle 0 and no timer, timestamp, or counter state, so every eligible update may clear pain.
dimensions.negative_proof: There is no cooldown to persist or reset; response latency is bounded by the next OnPlayerUpdate rather than a timer.

dimensions.positive_proof: A current-version new character receives a nonempty modData table containing UT_painImmune=true; IsoMovingObject.save serializes that table and load restores it, after which PainHook consumes the restored marker. PAIN itself is also serialized by Stats.
dimensions.negative_proof: No authorized in-game current-version save/reload was executed. Legacy saves lacking the marker and dynamic trait removal are not evidence of a current-version save/reload defect; backward migration is an explicit non-goal.

Cost changes from upstream 8 to UT 12 and selected exclusions expand to UT_glassbody, UT_sore, and UT_fibromyalgia.
Registration, namespace, definitions, reciprocal exclusions, EN keys, selected release copies, and UT_CORE package dependency are coherent.
